head: codex/5854-sprint5-readiness-current
title: [v0.92][readiness] Prepare Sprint 5 without starting child work
body:
Part of danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5854

Prepares the v0.92 Sprint 5 coordination umbrella and five operative child readiness contracts without binding or executing any child deliverable.

Review remediation:
- proves the split-authority bind-before-doctor route for #5835, #5836, #5838, #5839, and #5840
- reconciles the live umbrella, canonical issue wave, and execution packet to exactly five operative children
- classifies completed WP-24 as non-gating and WP-24A as an independent out-of-band stream
- restores the complete WP-19 serial gate
- enforces full issues/gate/boundary parity across machine YAML, canonical issue-wave YAML, and every human Safe Parallel Lanes row
- fails closed on malformed, extra, divergent, or path-overlapping parallel lanes
- records tooling issue #74 as closed and uses the recorded full FastWork lifecycle worktree with no sparse-checkout workaround

Validation:
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5854/validate-sprint-readiness.rb`: PASS
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5854/validate-sprint-readiness.rb --negative-overlap`: PASS
- typed `csdlc-validate issue --issue 5854`: PASS
- split-authority production bind regression: PASS
- `git diff --check`: PASS

Independent exact-head review passed at `f9a06470bbf088af51f4e168f4feedee556feb4f` with no P0-P2 findings. This is a non-closing readiness publication. It does not start Sprint 5, execute children, close #5854, merge this PR, deploy demos, or publish articles or media.
